proposed_features.name: zf_auc10y_mto / zf_auc10y_msince
proposed_features.source: Fleming, Liu, Nguyen (2026), Intraday Price Pressure and Order Flow Around U.S. Treasury Auctions, FRBNY Staff Report 1188 (March 2026, revised July 2026), Table 4
proposed_features.quote: 10-Year 1.013∗∗∗ 1.076∗∗∗ 1.259∗∗∗ 0.796∗∗∗ 1.192∗∗∗ 1.294∗∗∗ (5-Year column third); Auctions of 5-, 7-, and 10-year notes are associated with significant yield pressure across the entire curve.
proposed_features.formula: A10 = dates with a TREASURY_AUCTION row of tenor 10Y (frozen release calendar from 2019-05; ec_auc_2010_2019.json before); T = row instant_utc in America/Chicago. On ZF row (d,t): if d in A10 and t <= T: mto = (T - t) minutes, flag 1; if t > T: msince = (t - T) minutes, flag 1; else 0, flag 0. Same fixed_clock helper as ml_route_v2/signals/k2.py _auction with tenor 10Y.
calendars: TREASURY_AUCTION 10Y rows: ec_auc_2010_2019.json (106 rows in 2010-07-01..2019-05-05), frozen release calendar (59 rows in 2019-05-06..2024-02-29)
proposed_features.derivation: Spillover price pressure 1.259 bp yield x 4.40 = 5.54 bp over both 180-min legs (full sample 1991-2024). Clock shares from the 5y own-auction Figure 2(c) path (assumed to transfer): post leg t3->F 24% = 1.33 bp = 2.01 ticks (ratio 1.53); pre leg t2/h60 17% = 0.96 bp = 1.45 ticks (ratio 1.10). Decay-adjusted by the 10Y own-pressure ratio S3/full = 0.593/1.192: post leg about 1.0 tick (ratio 0.76). Value given = decay-adjusted post leg. Overlap: g13-g15 already include 10Y auctions in ZF's D8 list, mixed with other tenors, FOMC, NFP.
